title: Every ADR is listed in the ADR index, and the index lists no ADR without a file
assertion: Every ADR file (ADR-YYYYMMDD-xxxx-title.md) in the ADR folder ([adopted] adr_dir in .swerepo.toml, else docs/adr) is listed once in its README.md's index between the swerepo:adr-index markers, by its own row's link to the file ([ADR-YYYYMMDD-xxxx](file.md) in the first cell; an ID named elsewhere in a row doesn't count), and the index links no file that doesn't exist.

origin.text: SWERepo's hygiene rule pack (spec §6.8, ADR-20261124-cd64): seamspec/hygiene-adr-index@1.
